solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png]

VSUR is related to KHJG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b91c179f905c0c044d26150004e3b654537c83b2eb2e7347a9ee9820e60fc38.png] 

And,

YVXU is related to NKMJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d01f10e09bf6e2f78882205b1c509fbd8b8c7daf03f21d168760ade2327a0809.png]

SPRO is related to

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f75855abcd6058b8792c9d75c6199fa8220d0da2e300ba1730d846e0e1300c8.png]
